body: this seems to be related to #32125 as we minimize roundtrips by default from 7.0 on. I have tested field collapsing but there seems to be something that goes wrong with this request specifically, which I will look into. This issue can be worked around by passing the parameter `ccs_minimize_roundtrips` set to `false` until the problem is resolved.

issue.title: CCS: skip empty search hits when minimizing round-trips

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When minimizing round-trips in CCS, each cluster returns its own independent
search response. In case sort by field and/or field collapsing were
requested, when one cluster has no results to return, the information
about the field that sorting was based on (`SortField` array) as well as
the field (and the values) that collapsing was performed on are missing
in the search response. That causes problems as we can't build the
proper `TopDocs` instance for empty results which would need to be 
either `TopFieldDocs` or `CollapseTopFieldDocs`. The merge routine 
expects all the top docs of the same exact type which can't be guaranteed 
when some cluster returns results and some other doesn't. Given that
the problematic results are empty, hence have no impact on the final
results, we can simply skip them.

Relates to #32125
Closes #40067
